description: Experimental binary-only GPU compensated certificate; not production code. IEEE decoder omits important floating-point cases; GPU-only timings exclude input transport.
limitations: Scratch experiment only; not integrated in the library.
Metal timing excludes GPU input allocation and transport; small number of warm repetitions; not end-to-end.
Binary only; objective partial reduction, bias splitting, weighting setup and float64 byte-view transport use NumPy on host.
Float64 byte decoder assumes little-endian normal finite values in float32-representable exponent range, and does not correctly handle zeros, subnormals, infinities, NaNs or larger exponents.
Compensated polynomial sigmoid and double-float arithmetic have no proven global error bounds; no universal certification claim.
The float32 fixture reads model parameters from benchmarks/results/certified-offset-final-2026-10-27.json. CPU float64 calculations provide fixture generation and independent verification.
